name: Earthmender Torlok
shortDescription: An Earthen Ring earthmender involved in the request to aid the Shadowmoon spirits.
body: An Earthen Ring earthmender involved in the request to aid the Shadowmoon spirits. Visual details are original generated research art, not canonical model evidence. Composition, markings, costume and exact game resemblance await human comparison with the target Burning Crusade client.
